questions.question: Walk me through your process for completing month-end close, including the journal entries, accrual schedules, and balance-sheet reconciliations you prepare.
In your Accountant II role at Ellwood Group, how did you investigate and resolve reconciling items identified during balance-sheet or fixed-asset reconciliations?
Describe your experience preparing monthly accruals. How do you determine the appropriate amount, document the support, and reverse or true up the accrual in a subsequent period?

This role is responsible for lease-accounting schedules. Your Bloomberg experience included reviewing leases and contractual obligations in financial statements; how would you approach building and maintaining a lease schedule under US GAAP?

Tell me about the monthly financial reporting packages and closing procedures you prepared at George Washington University. What reports were included, and how did you ensure the information was accurate and delivered on time?

Describe an example of variance or flux analysis you performed, such as the YTD P&L budget-versus-actual reporting at George Washington University. How did you identify the driver and communicate the result?
What experience do you have maintaining fixed-asset registers, calculating depreciation, and assessing whether invoices should be capitalized or expensed?
How have you used Excel to prepare reconciliations, roll-forward schedules, depreciation calculations, or financial reports? Which functions, formulas, or tools do you use most often?
Give an example of working with Accounts Payable, Purchasing, or another operating department to resolve an accounting issue. What was the issue, and what was the outcome?
When preparing a balance-sheet account reconciliation, what support and review steps do you use to ensure the account is complete, accurate, and compliant with accounting policy?
